card.name: Count words in technical documentation rules
card.fires_on: Small count or quantity words such as one, two, no, same and an, placed right after a verb or 'exactly' in technical manuals. They state how many of something there are.

modes.label: Exactly one
modes.description: The word one after exactly, only or consist of, stating a single allowed item.
modes.example: Each document must have exactly<< one>> TITLE within the HEAD.
